_classes.name: Section-specific effective dates in the act clause not captured in section_dates, so records from those sections carry the act-level date
_classes.rule: effective_dates entry where re.search(r'sections? [^.;]{0,120}? of this act shall take effect', raw_clause, re.I) and section_dates == [] ; count stored duty/power records of those laws (some hits are same-as-chapter or relative dates, still unmodelled)
_classes.db_note: 29 laws with records; 468 laws do have section_dates populated, so the parser handles some forms

_classes.name: Deemed-timely review sentence ('If accepted, the application shall be reviewed as if it had been received on or before the taxable status date') stored as a separate duty; it is a condition of the accept-application power
_classes.rule: kind == 'duty' and re.search(r'shall be reviewed as if', quote, re.I)

_classes.name: Recurrence of fixed class 'act-level sunsets after a proviso missing from expires_date': 'the amendments made by section one of this act shall expire and be deemed repealed April 1, 2015' left expires_date null
_classes.rule: effective_dates entry with expires_date null and re.search(r'((?<!of )this act|(the )?amendments made by section one of this act|(?<!s )section one of this act) shall expire and be deemed repealed (on )?<Month> \d{1,2},? \d{4}', raw_clause, re.I)
_classes.db_note: 8 of 11 laws matching the pattern have expires_date null: 2011-A4786, 2011-A7487, 2013-S1759, 2013-A6442 and 4 more; 7 stored records across them
